public_definitions: Goal: Review the public infrastructure grant application dashboard, compare the 2013 application volume for United States and Canada, then open the country grant intake follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume.
Routing criterion: Larger 2013 country application volume shown in the dashboard.
uncertain: The specific numerical values for the 2013 data points are not explicitly labeled on the chart, so the comparison relies on the relative vertical position of the markers.
The chart uses dual y-axes (left for United States, right for Canada), which could imply different scales, but the visual comparison of marker heights is the primary evidence provided.
